note: MyCity's names for its functions, posts and seats, checked against the Org Chart (October) on 22/10/2026 (docs/guides/performance.md §6.20, P4, P5). The staff loader applies this on every deploy, before and after the sheet: a department named under `was` is renamed in place (same id, nobody moved out), a department in `merge` gives its people to this one and is retired when empty, a post or seat still holding an old title takes the new one, the posts under `moves` go to their department, and an empty head is filled. Each step changes only what still holds the old value, so an edit made on screen stays and a second deploy changes nothing. No names: people are matched by their post. TB, 22/10/2026.
